messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف أسماء أو معلومات غير موجودة في النص، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON مطابقاً للمخطط فقط. يجب أن تكون chapter وverse عددين صحيحين بأرقام 0-9، وأن يكون text_ar ترجمة الوحدة وحدها.

{"chapter":7,"verses":[{"chapter":7,"verse":6,"text":"Now when for time first time they had come to me and I had shown them my precious stones, they were astonished and said :"},{"chapter":7,"verse":7,"text":"\"If of us three kings all our possessions would be brought together into one, it would not come up to the precious stones of .Jobabs kingdom (crown). For thou art of greater nobility than all the people of the East."},{"chapter":7,"verse":8,"text":"And when, therefore, they now came to the land of Ausitis \"Uz\" to visit me, they asked in the city : \"Where is Jobab, the ruler of this whole land\""},{"chapter":7,"verse":9,"text":"And they told them concerning me: \"He sitteth upon the dung-hill outside of the city for he has not entered the city for seven years\"."},{"chapter":7,"verse":10,"text":"And then again they- inquired concerning my possessions, and there was revealed to them all that happened to me."}],"book_code":"TJOB"}
